data.title: 桃乐丝 · 乐土海湾的玫瑰冰茶
data.description: 【伊甸园海湾露台·午后】桃乐丝穿着白粉色泳装坐在白色海湾露台，手边摆着玫瑰冰茶与一把小剪刀；她修剪一枝被风折弯的花后，把盛开的花推向镜头，紫瞳里带着从容而明亮的满足。
data.action: 海湾露台修好被风折弯的玫瑰，把重新盛开的花推向镜头
data.lighting: bright afternoon sea light and soft rose shadows
data.mood: 把乐土的美好变成可分享的假日
data.promptProse: Dorothy from Goddess of Victory: NIKKE wears a white-and-pink resort swimsuit with a sheer garden wrap, rose hair ribbon and a glass of rose iced tea. She sits on Eden’s seaside terrace with rose iced tea beside a small pair of garden shears. She straightens a wind-bent bloom, then slides the restored flower toward the viewer, her measured smile gaining genuine warmth against the bright water. bright afternoon sea light and soft rose shadows.
